result.instructions: Tools for MailerCheck, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many MailerCheck verification credits remain?"; "Show my email verification lists and their status."; "Verify this email after I confirm the credit charge, then read its result.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes MailerCheck data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run mailercheck_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run mailercheck_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run mailercheck_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. mailercheck_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: mailercheck_account
tools.title: Read MailerCheck account
tools.description: Read the connected MailerCheck account name, ID and credit balance. Does not verify emails or spend verification credits.

tools.name: mailercheck_credits
tools.title: Check MailerCheck credits
tools.description: Read the available MailerCheck verification credit balance without starting verification.

tools.name: mailercheck_lists
tools.title: List MailerCheck verification lists
tools.description: Read one bounded page of list summaries, processing status and statistics. Does not create, verify or delete lists. Pagination stays on the MailerCheck API; no response links are followed.

tools.name: mailercheck_get_list
tools.title: Read MailerCheck list status
tools.description: Read one existing list's verification status and aggregate result counts. Does not start or restart verification.

tools.name: mailercheck_verify_email
tools.title: Start MailerCheck email verification
tools.description: Submit one email for asynchronous verification. Spends MailerCheck credits and requires confirm:true. This call is never retried. Read the returned verification ID with mailercheck_verification_result; wait between polls. If the response is lost, check MailerCheck before submitting again.

tools.name: mailercheck_verification_result
tools.title: Read MailerCheck email verification result
tools.description: Read the status and result of a previously submitted asynchronous email check. Does not start new verification. Call once and wait before polling again; no automatic polling is performed.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with MailerCheck
prompts.description: What you can do with MailerCheck here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: check_verification_capacity
prompts.title: Check verification capacity
prompts.description: Read your connected account and remaining MailerCheck credits before submitting an email for verification.

prompts.name: review_list_verification_progress
prompts.title: Review list verification progress
prompts.description: Browse existing verification lists, then inspect a list’s processing status and aggregate result counts.

prompts.name: verify_a_new_email_address
prompts.title: Verify a new email address
prompts.description: Confirm MailerCheck credit usage to submit one email for asynchronous verification. Keep its verification ID and read the status and result later, waiting between checks.
